newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia '97 GDP seen at 3 pct, inflation 15.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Estonia '97 GDP seen at 3 pct, inflation 15.2 pct.

text.p: Estonian Finance Minister Mart Opmann said on Thursday that next year's gross domestic product (GDP) is expected to rise by three percent and year-on-year inflation is seen at 15.2 percent.

"Next year's budget is the first one for Estonia which considers GDP growth as priority number one and changes in the consumer price index (CPI) a less important factor," Opmann told a news conference.
Opmann made the comments after parliament yesterday approved the 1997 budget, which by law had to be balanced.
In 1997, GDP is expected to reach 60.15 billion kroons versus 51 billion kroons this year, the finance ministry said in a statement.
It added that year-on-year inflation is expected to be 15.2 percent in December 1997.

"Next year's CPI will probably be lower than we have forecast but it is very possible that GDP will grow more, although we made the budget on the most pessimistic basis," said Agu Lellep, finance ministry chancellor.
